summary: 1936 CCC-built 60-foot steel fire tower on Minechoag Mountain in Ludlow State Forest; NHLR-registered 2002; standing and fenced; newest visit report 2016.

facts.design: 60-foot steel tower; original 7 by 7 foot metal cab, replaced in 1967 with a 10 by 10 foot aluminum cab, upgraded again in 1999

access.note: Tower is inside a chain link fence topped with barbed wire, per the April 2016 NHLR visit report. No newer source on access was found, and no source says the public may climb it.

visit.trail_note: Does not appear on trail maps and is relatively isolated (NHLR visit report, April 2016).

corrections.why: The 2015 chapter report lists new landing platforms among maintenance repairs. The source does not describe a restoration to an earlier state.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says CCC tower construction was begun in 1936. Forest Lookouts says the CCC erected the tower that year. Both give 1936, so the story uses 1936 and says no completion date is given.
NHLR describes the site as in the Ludlow State Forest, but its April 2016 visit report says Ludlow State Park. The story uses the forest name, which the register's description uses.

sources.title: Southern New England chapter report for 2015

notes_for_editor: Three sources, all read. The NHLR page is the substantive one: 2002 registration, cab history, and an April 2016 visit report. Current access and staffing rest on that 2016 report; no newer source was readable. AllTrails (HTTP 403) and the Roamful and MyHikes listings appeared in search but were not readable, so none is cited. Two Forest Fire Lookout Association Massachusetts Facebook posts (fall 1936 build, April 1937 opening, 1950 radio) returned login walls and are not used; they are worth checking if a later pass can read them. The brief's 2015 'restored' event is proposed as 'modified' in corrections. Not verified: whether the tower has changed status since April 2016, and whether the public may climb it. No photos added.
